cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Wonderful promotion. Your timing with the director's retirement was beautiful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And how considerate of the vacancy to arrive when you were ready.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm choosing the most generous version available this morning.

mechanism: A presumes the authority to approve the winner publicly and packages increasingly resentful comparisons inside warm congratulations, deciding what praise B is entitled to accept.
confusable: Open insult is confusable: A must continue performing a compliment even as competitive resentment leaks through it.
comparison: Prize presentation exposes A belief in higher standards; colleague promotion exposes resentment of the vacancy that let B advance.
seedUse: Read both exact cards and four canonical seeds. Preserve B challenge to backhanded praise, but keep actual compliments alive rather than ending only in a complaint about A own effort.
